reverse_engineering.reporter_path: window.onload renders React UI; an effect loads ZipReader(Data64URIReader(window.playwrightReportBase64), {useWebWorkers:false}); report.json and per-test JSON are read and JSON.parse supplies the UI.
reverse_engineering.output_path: Test errors are escaped for &, quotes and angle brackets before ANSI-to-HTML conversion, then rendered as report markup. The ANSI converter imports entity-codec exports and has an optional escapeXML path.
reverse_engineering.pair_read: Module 7322 selects native codePointAt or a fallback: 1024*(e.charCodeAt(0)-55296)+e.charCodeAt(1)-56320+65536. The result goes to g(e), which formats an HTML numeric entity (&#x...;).
reverse_engineering.character_construction: Separate module 26 selects native String.fromCodePoint or splits a code point into high/low UTF-16 surrogates with fromCharCode. Module 4076 uses it when decoding numeric HTML entities. These exports are aggregated by module 5863.
reverse_engineering.example: U+1F600 corresponds to UTF-16 code units 55357,56832. The flagged arithmetic returns 128512; entity formatting yields 😀. These are Unicode conversions, not concealed code.
reverse_engineering.network_context: The ZIP library also contains generic fetch/XMLHttpRequest readers; the report-load path uses its embedded Base64 data reader. No network sink receives the character-code result.
reverse_engineering.decoded_facts: HTML facts inspected: 434 RawScan strings, one URL-decoded bundled-code span, one Unicode-escape-decoded source span, and one short non-executable Base64 candidate. No hidden executable stage identified.
reverse_engineering.effects: No hostile behavior found in the flagged code or the release diff. The two code changes affect cookie selection for requested localhost URLs.

trait_change.reason: Two character-code reads and a nearby fromCharCode call establish neither a shared value nor concealment. The composite inferred data flow between different module functions.
trait_change.other_composites: treewalk-charcode-document-write matcher, scope, severity and mappings unchanged; no consumers referenced the retired ID.
